requisitoLingua.citazione: Exchange students should have at least a B2 level of language proficiency in the language of instruction (English or German, depending on the degree program and selected courses).
the minimum requirement for students wishing to study at the University of Jyväskylä as exchange students is level B1. Applicants should preferably be B2 (or higher)
